name: Bat Boy: The Musical
venue: The Sarasota Players, The Crossings at Siesta Key
address: 3501 S Tamiami Trail, Suite 1130, Sarasota, FL 34239
dates_label: Opens Wednesday, Aug 26, runs through Sept 6
blurb: The Sarasota Players open their season with the cult comedy horror musical about a half boy, half bat creature found in a West Virginia cave. It is campy, loud and surprisingly tender, staged at the company's home in The Crossings at Siesta Key. Adult subject matter: recommended for ages 18 and up. Showtimes and tickets are at theplayers.org.

name: Laser Light Nights at The Bishop
venue: The Bishop Museum of Science and Nature
hours_label: 6 PM Thursday, 6 and 7 PM Friday and Saturday · Ticketed
blurb: The Bishop's planetarium dome turns into a full sensory concert, with synchronized lasers and visuals set to Queen, Pink Floyd, Elton John, Taylor Swift, Metallica and more. Each night runs a different album, so check the schedule before you pick a show. Shows at 6 PM Thursdays, 6 and 7 PM Fridays and Saturdays through the season finale on Sept 6; doors open at 5:30 PM and tickets are sold online at bishopscience.org.
photo_credit: Photo: The Bishop Museum of Science and Nature

name: Classic Movies at the Opera House: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
blurb: The 1971 Gene Wilder original screens on the big screen inside the restored 1926 Sarasota Opera House downtown. It is 98 minutes, tickets are $12, and the building itself is worth the price of admission. Part of the Opera House summer classic movie series.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
venue: Downtown Sarasota, Lemon Ave & Main St
blurb: Every Saturday morning, Lemon Avenue and Main Street close to traffic for produce, seafood, baked goods, plants and prepared breakfast from local vendors. It is the best hour of the week to feel out downtown Sarasota on foot. Free to walk, rain or shine.
